messages:
maria-sales: Heads up — packaging up the pen test + vuln-scan evidence for ACME's vendor risk review. Need the final bundle (encrypted) plus a remediation timeline and owner assignment by EOD Thu so their security team can review before Friday. Links and details below.

sam-se: Thanks — what's your expected format? single ZIP with docs + export CSV mapping CVEs to our tickets?

devin-engsec: Yes single encrypted ZIP is ideal. I'll add: pen-test-report.pdf, vuln-scan-results.csv, cve-to-ticket.csv, sanitization.txt, network-snapshots.tar.gz. Uploading to S3 now and will share link + sha256. Passphrase via 1Password team vault.

scan-bot: upload complete — s3://redwood-security/acme-risk-review/1802003456/pentest_bundle_encrypted.zip (access: restricted)

devin-engsec: S3 link above. sha256: 3f7a9b2d1c4e6f7a9b2d1c4e6f7a9b2d1c4e6f7a9b2d1c4e6f7a9b2d1c4e6f7a9
Command to verify locally:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-security/acme-risk-review/1802003456/pentest_bundle_encrypted.zip . && sha256sum pentest_bundle_encrypted.zip
```
Passphrase shared in 1Password: ACME Risk Review / pen-test bundle (restrict to @zoe-compliance, @sam-se).

lee-infra: I put staging logs & docker image digests in the bundle too. Image digests: redwood/runtime:latest@sha256:aa12ff... and redwood/ingest@sha256:bb34cc...

zoe-compliance: Quick checklist from my side: 1) Signed SOC2 scoping note (included?) 2) Completed CAIQ extract (we should attach the subset ACME requested) 3) CVE mapping CSV with status and mitigation steps. Please make sure each CVE row has ticket link, owner, severity.

devin-engsec: Will include SOC2 scope PDF and CAIQ subset CSV. I'll generate the CVE mapping from JIRA — format: cve, jira_ticket, owner, severity, status, eta. Sample row: CVE-2023-XXXX, PROJ-1234, lee-infra, P1, in-progress, 2026-04-10

tonY-customer-success: @maria-sales can you confirm we have remediation ETAs per severity? ACME expects a timeline they can present to their board. They want P1s in 2 weeks max.

maria-sales: Confirming — Devin proposed P1 = 2 weeks, P2 = 4–6 weeks, P3 = scheduled in next quarterly backlog. We'll mark owners and expected completion dates.

devin-engsec: Draft remediation timeline I'll add to the bundle (remediation_timeline.md):
- P1 (critical / exploitable): owners = lee-infra + devsec; target = 2026-04-09
- P2 (high): owners = app-team; target = 2026-04-30 to 2026-05-14
- P3 (medium/low): owners = backlog; target = next quarter (TBD)
I'll also include per-ticket notes where mitigation requires config changes vs. code changes.

zoe-compliance: Please attach the auditor-facing summary (one page) that maps each P1 to compensating controls and risk acceptance notes — ACME often asks for that.

devin-engsec: Will do. Also sanitization note: all customer data redacted prior to upload, see sanitization.txt inside root of ZIP.

sam-se: Two quick asks from presales: 1) confirm there is no customer PII in screenshots/logs. 2) share the contact for the remediation owners so ACME can route questions.

devin-engsec: 1) Confirmed, sanitized. 2) Owner contact list included: lee-infra (lee@redwood.com), app-team lead (yana@app.redwood.com), devsec (devin@redwood.com).

maria-sales: Let's set a 30-min sync with ACME for Friday to walk through the bundle and timeline. Proposed: Fri 10:00 PT. If that works I can calendar-invite. @triage-bot can you create tentative slot? :calendar:

triage-bot: Calendar event created: ACME vendor-risk walkthrough — Fri 10:00 PT — provisional invite sent to ACME, @zoe-compliance, @devin-engsec, @maria-sales, @sam-se. Link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123

lee-infra: One FYI — one P1 is a container runtime CVE that requires an infra-side patch + canary rollout. I'll need the canary window (we should schedule downtime-free canary next week).

maria-sales: Noted. We'll include canary plan in the remediation notes and flag the canary window in the calendar invite.

zoe-compliance: After bundle review I'll provide a short sign-off statement we can send to ACME once internal validation is done. Target: sign-off prior to the Friday walkthrough.

maria-sales: Great team — final deliverable checklist before EOD Thu: encrypted ZIP in S3, sha256 checksum, 1Password passphrase shared with @zoe-compliance & @sam-se, remediation_timeline.md, CVE mapping CSV with JIRA links, SOC2 scope, CAIQ subset, sanitization.txt, owner contact list, auditor one-pager. I'll follow up if anything missing. Thanks! :pray:
